propositions: Rotation timestamps must be migrated from inline bindings.json fields into a new .bridge_state/get_rotation.json sidecar file while maintaining backward compatibility with old binaries
New binaries write rotation state to both the sidecar and legacy inline fields, then read max(sidecar, legacy) to ensure correct ordering across mixed-version deployments
The sidecar file must be persisted only through BindingStore.save() to cover production save paths without affecting reconcile-check or creating orphaned files
The new get_rotation.py module boundary extracts cohesive rotation load/save/max logic as a dedicated seam rather than violating the 800-line policy on BindingStore and outbound_differ
Local git staging and reconciliation must recognize and commit get_rotation.json as a regenerable bridge-state file alongside bindings.json using explicit staging and basename checks
